justification: Panel A shows a chariot hunting scene with a horse, hunter with bow, and a dying lion, while panel B shows two standing human figures facing each other with hieroglyphic-style inscriptions and a small stand or altar between them. The only broad commonality is the presence of a human figure in profile; the subject matter, relationships (hunting/violence vs. presentation/offering), and arrangement (dynamic action scene vs. static formal composition with text bands) are entirely different.
